card.name: Openness to new things or infections
card.fires_on: Words after 'new' or after 'susceptibility/receptive/open', such as 'to' or 'for', where the text says something is open or vulnerable to something incoming. Also 'things' or 'infections' right after 'new'.

modes.label: After 'new'
modes.description: The noun or word right after 'new' where something new is being taken in or acquired.
modes.example: Reduce resistance to new<< infections>> • Exacerbate existing infections

modes.label: Openness linking word
modes.description: The word 'to' or 'for' after an adjective of being open, susceptible or receptive.
modes.example: which can increase susceptibility<< to>> infection, combination immunosuppressant

card.plain: It fires on words that mark something as open or vulnerable to new things coming in, like new infections.
